correctness.rationale: For each predictor/corrector coefficient pair, J²=-I gives the exact scalar-plus-skew update and squared-norm multiplier. Averaging over the complete fixed-marginal 2x2 coupling polytope gives affine q(theta), and iteration independence gives E||z_k||²=q(theta)^k||z_0||². Exact factorizations identify the unique switching step, all three mean-square stability thresholds and quartic P(r); P(r)/r²=(r+1/r)²-2(r+1/r)-4 gives the unique heterogeneity cutoff. The rational witness and 1490 exact-rational checker assertions validate arithmetic; no finite test substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Sampling at the two stages is a genuine algorithm-design degree of freedom at identical two-oracle cost. For bilinear saddle components with unequal magnitudes, antithetic pairing can mean-square contract when both established same-sample and independent-sample policies diverge. The finding supplies a globally optimal binary fixed-marginal pair law and a sharp natural heterogeneity boundary, rather than an arbitrarily chosen counterexample. The result does not claim general stochastic game applicability.
